title: Leaked files show Deutsche Bank protected Russian profits despite warnings
html:
The bank’s clients included Russian billionaires, some with ties to the Kremlin.

PHOTO: REUTERS

Russ Buettner, Khadija Sharife, Brian Fitzpatrick, Frederik Obermaier, Bastian Obermayer and Sophia Baumann

AI generated

FRANKFURT, Germany – When Russian missiles began pummelling Ukraine in February 2022, executives at one of the world’s largest banks sensed trouble headed their way.

Within hours of an invasion that set off a war that is now in its fifth year, Western governments issued new financial sanctions intended to further isolate Russia from the world economy.
summary: The bank’s clients included Russian billionaires, some with ties to the Kremlin.
